People: Jane Austen (author, Wikidata Q36322), died 1877; Susan Coolidge (other, Wikidata Q2915918), died 1905. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Austen, Jane, 1775-1817; Coolidge, Susan, 1835-1905 [Compiler]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's (Wikidata gives some of them several death years, every one 1925 or earlier: Jane Austen [1817, 1877]).

Printed edition: THe Letters Jane AUsten, 1892, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/lettersjaneauste0000sara. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 100%, 81%, 50% of their four-word runs in the scan's text.
